summary: Joint-order group ID; all tasks in the group are assigned together, or none are.
businessRules: Atomic group: if any member is infeasible, the whole group is unassigned.

joint_order defines: Specify a joint order group ID that this job is associated with. Tasks having the same joint order group ID are treated as a single unit: either all tasks in the group are assigned, or none are. Us…
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: two jobs sharing joint_order 7 both assigned.
Infeasible: one member of a joint_order group infeasible -> the whole group unassigned.
